_comment: One entry per lab with tests: the tests job of .github/workflows/tests.yml runs install then test in the lab directory,
and tools/ci/run_local.sh runs the same commands in a fresh venv per lab (bash, in the lab directory). install is what
the lab's README says, minus anything that pulls in torch (T0: no torch, no GPU, no Docker, no keys); solutions (optional) is the manual solutions job.
tools/ci/ci.py check fails when a directory with tests is missing here.
